content: आसुर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [असुरस्येदम् अण् <ab>opp.</ab> दैव] .²1 Belonging to {%Asuras%}. .²2 Belonging to evil spirits; आसुरी माया, आसुरी रात्रिः <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Infernal, demoniacal; आसुरं भावमाश्रितः <ls>Bg. 7. 15</ls> (for a full exposition of what constitutes आसुर conduct, see <ls>Bg. 16. 7-24</ls>). .²4 Not performing sacrifices. .²5 Divine, spiritual. .{@-रः@} .²1 A demon [स्वार्थे अण्]. .²2 One of the eight forms of marriage, in which the bridegroom purchases the bride from her father or other paternal kinsmen; (see उद्वाह); आसुरो द्रविणादानात् <ls>Y. 1. 61</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 31</ls>. .²3 (<ab>pl.</ab>) The stars of the southern hemisphere. .²4 A prince of the warrior-tribe Asura. .{@-री@} .²1 Surgery, curing by cutting by instruments. .²2 A female demon, demoness; संभ्रमादासुरीभिः <ls>Ve. 1. 3</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant Sinapis Ramosa Roxb. (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>मोहरी</ns>; राई) .{@-रम्@} .²1 Blood. .²2 Black salt.
